extracted.name: Cast Iron Pineapple Upside Down Cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Cast Iron Pineapple Upside Down Cake.
instruction_lines: Melt 3 tbsp of butter in cast iron and add brown sugar. Mix. Allow to simmer for about 5 minutes. Add pineapple slices, covering the bottom of the pan. Place cherries in centers of pineapples and open spaces if desired. Remove from heat.
Dry ingredients: Mix flour, baking powder and salt in separate bowl.
Prepare cake batter. Cream softened butter and sugar together. Add vanilla. Mix
Add egg yolks one at a time and mix until smooth.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Alternate adding pineapple juice and dry ingredients to batter while mixing.
Pour batter into cast iron pan
Bake for 30-35 minutes until center is set and toothpick inserted in cake come out clean
Invert cake onto serving dish and serve
